summary: Moyale Airport (MYS) is a small regional airport serving the border town of Moyale in southern Ethiopia, near the Kenya border. It primarily supports domestic connectivity in the Borena Zone of the Oromia Region, with limited scheduled service. The airport plays an important role for the local pastoralist communities and cross-border trade activity in this remote area.
faqs:
Q: Where is Moyale Airport located?
A: Moyale Airport is located in Moyale, a town in southern Ethiopia near the border with Kenya, in the Borena Zone of the Oromia Region.

Q: Does Moyale Airport have international flights?
A: No, Moyale Airport primarily handles domestic flights, though its proximity to the Kenya border makes it strategically important for regional travel.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small regional airport, Moyale Airport offers basic facilities. Travelers should not expect extensive amenities and should plan accordingly.

Q: Which airlines operate at Moyale Airport?
A: Ethiopian Airlines and other regional carriers have historically operated routes serving this airport, though schedules may be limited.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short distance from Moyale town center, typically reachable by local taxi or shared transport. Given the remote location, road conditions can vary significantly by season, so travelers should allow extra time. Travelers heading to or from Kenya should be aware that Moyale straddles the border, with a separate Moyale Airport existing on the Kenyan side.
local_tip: Carry sufficient water and sun protection, as Moyale sits in a semi-arid region where temperatures can be very high, especially if you end up waiting outdoors during delays or for ground transport.
